content.user_title: Draft US Rental Paperwork and Deposit Statements
content.value_statement: Small rental portfolios need consistent paperwork across screening, leasing, notices, and move-out accounting. This guide helps an AI assistant prepare structured drafts for local verification.
actual_capabilities: Outline tenant screening workflows with consistent application criteria and adverse action notice drafts.
Draft lease packets with a core lease, state addenda, and required disclosure checklists.
Prepare late-rent, cure-or-quit, entry, and non-renewal notice drafts.
Structure move-out accounting with itemized deductions and deposit return deadline verification.
Request state and city details to identify jurisdiction-specific questions before finalizing documents.
limitations: This folder contains only a public guide, without the original scripts, extension source, or templates.
Coverage is limited to US residential rentals; state and city requirements need current independent verification.
Outputs are working drafts, not legal advice or guarantees of compliance.
The skill does not file evictions; eviction and deposit disputes require licensed counsel.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Lease Packet
use_cases.description: Organize a core lease draft, jurisdiction-specific addenda, and disclosure checklist for a new tenancy.

use_cases.title: Standardize Applicant Screening
use_cases.description: Create a consistent screening workflow and adverse action notice draft for review against fair housing requirements.

use_cases.title: Organize Move-Out Accounting
use_cases.description: Turn deposit records and documented deductions into an itemized draft with a deadline verification checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Screening Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a tenant screening checklist for a rental in [city, state]. Include consistent criteria, fair housing review points, and adverse action notice requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: organize an initial screening workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Assemble a Lease Packet
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a lease packet outline for [city, state] using [redacted tenancy terms]. Separate core terms, state addenda, disclosures, and questions requiring verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare documents for a new tenancy.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile a Security Deposit
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a move-out statement using [deposit amount], [redacted deduction records], and [move-out date] for [city, state]. Show arithmetic and flag unverified legal deadlines.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: reconcile deposit accounting and supporting records.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Notice Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [redacted lease terms], [rent ledger], and [verified local requirements], draft a notice sequence for [city, state].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: distinguish administrative drafts from legal action requiring counsel.

output_examples.input: Create a beginner screening checklist for a rental in my city and state.
output: Confirm the property jurisdiction and applicable screening requirements.
Document consistent application criteria for fair housing review.
Use the same review process for each applicant.
Prepare an adverse action notice draft when applicable, subject to legal verification.

output_examples.input: Draft a move-out accounting summary for a $1,500 deposit and $175 in documented proposed deductions.
output: Proposed deductions: $175, subject to itemization and legal review.
Provisional refund: $1,325, assuming all proposed deductions are allowed and no other adjustments apply.
Before sending: confirm jurisdiction, move-out date, statutory deadline, and supporting records.

best_practices: Provide the property state, city, relevant dates, and redacted lease terms before requesting a draft.
Verify deadlines, notice periods, required disclosures, and deduction rules against current authoritative sources.
Keep supporting records and obtain licensed counsel review for eviction or deposit disputes.
anti_patterns: Sending generated notices without checking local law, service requirements, and factual accuracy.
Using inconsistent screening criteria or treating generated guidance as a fair housing compliance guarantee.
Sharing unnecessary tenant identifiers, financial account details, or unredacted application records.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. The source declares compatibility with SKILL.md-compatible agents.

faq.question: Does this package include automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The folder contains only the public guide. Original scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.

faq.question: How does it account for local rental laws?
faq.answer: It asks for the state and city and requires verification of specific legal requirements before documents are finalized.

faq.question: What can it prepare for a lease packet?
faq.answer: It guides drafts of a core lease, state-specific addenda, and a checklist of required disclosures.

faq.question: Can it help with security deposit returns?
faq.answer: It structures move-out accounting and itemized deduction drafts. Applicable deadlines and permitted deductions still need independent verification.

faq.question: Can it file an eviction or replace legal counsel?
faq.answer: No. It provides administrative working drafts, not legal advice. Licensed counsel should review eviction filings and deposit disputes.
